land.text: Loulan (Shanshan) and Gaochang in 442, the year of the exile's two conquests

predecessors.note: The Juqu 'continued to hold out in the far northwest and attempted to revive their state in their former territory': Northern Liang fell at Guzang in 439, the last seats were Jiuquan (440-441) and Dunhuang (441-442); in 442 Juqu Wuhui abandoned Dunhuang and joined Juqu Anzhou, who had taken Loulan in spring 442. The exile regime has no land from the old Hexi realm.

ledger.note: Spring 442: Juqu Anzhou takes Loulan. 'In the spring of 442 CE, Loulan was invaded by Juqu Anzhou and its king fled to Jumo (Cherchen)' (Shanshan page); Juqu Wuhui, who had abandoned Dunhuang, joined him (Wuhui page). Infobox 'Capital-in-exile: Shanshan (442)'.

region.text: Gaochang, 'the oasis city of Gaochang' (Northern Liang page), drawn as a 120 km disc as in the kingdom-of-gaochang dossier

ledger.note: Fall 442: Juqu Wuhui takes Gaochang. 'In fall 442, Juqu Wuhui made a surprise attack on Gaochang, capturing it'; the Northern Liang page: 'remnants of the Juqu clan fled and occupied the oasis city of Gaochang in 442'. The Juqu Wuhui page names the holder: Kan Shuang (闞爽), who had refused Wuhui entry, 'fled to Rouran'. [Reviewer ea-03-x: counterpart 'Gaochang (holder not named)' replaced by the page's name.]

444: Wuhui dies and Anzhou becomes Prince of Hexi. 'In 444, Juqu Wuhui died, and Juqu Anzhou succeeded him'; 'Late in 444, Emperor Wen of Liu Song officially created Juqu Anzhou the Prince of Hexi' (the Northern Liang page: Wuhui 'submitted to the Liu Song' in 444). The Liu Song dossier should carry the vassal_start (counterpart northern-liang-of-gaochang).

wars.note: Wuhui and Anzhou were refugees from Northern Wei's conquest of the Hexi (Jiuquan fell in winter 441).

wars.outcome: The Rouran killed Juqu Anzhou and his clan and installed Kan Bozhou as King of Gaochang.
wars.note: The Northern Liang page: the Juqu 'attempted to maintain friendly relations with the Rouran Khaganate'; the reason for the attack is 'unknown'.

certainty.note: A refugee regime on an oasis: no boundary on any page; Gaochang is a disc.

notes: State Cliopatria lacks; slug northern-liang-of-gaochang, as the northern-liang dossier (dissolve 442) and kingdom-of-gaochang (starts 460) ask. Not found on the pages: the 439 flight to Gaochang that kingdom-of-gaochang's note gives (the Northern Liang page dates the occupation of Gaochang to 442, the Juqu Wuhui page to fall 442); who held Gaochang before 442; whether Loulan stayed Juqu land (Shanshan has kings in Qiemo and 'Zhenda' 441-445); the Northern Wei campaign in the Tarim of 445. The Liu Song 'King/Prince of Hexi' recognition (444) should be a vassal_start in the liu-song-dynasty dossier; the kingdom-of-gaochang dossier's predecessor should be this slug. Counterpart without a dossier: Shanshan (Loulan), slug shanshan, years about -77 to 645, group ea-02 or ia-01.
